description: Looks up private foundations by name, part of a name, or 9-digit EIN and returns matching profiles with location, annual giving, the number of recorded grants and how each one matched: exact name, a known everyday name, or a name containing every distinctive word given. Name and EIN lookup only; searching by mission or topic is not supported here. Covers private foundations that file IRS Form 990-PF; community foundations and other public charities are not included. Inputs: query, and optional states, min_annual_giving and limit. Available to signed-in accounts; without sign-in the server asks the client to sign in. Counts toward the search allowance.

min_annual_giving.description: Minimum annual giving in US dollars; narrows the matches.

query.description: A private-foundation name, part of a name, or 9-digit EIN. Examples: "Cafritz Foundation", "Kresge" or "562618866". Foundations are matched by name, part of a name or EIN; states and min_annual_giving narrow those matches.

states.description: States where the foundation is based (2-letter codes); narrows the name or EIN matches.

name: search_foundations
title: Search Foundations
